notes.title: [Announcement] PATCH NOTES - UPDATE: 08/09/2025
notes.notes:
[p]🌙✨ Good morning, Warriors of Brívia!! ⚔️🔥[/p][p]📢 Announcement:[/p][p]We're back.[/p][p]What's up?[/p][p]Small - Patch Notes:[/p][p]- Smoother camera movement.[/p][p]- Character shadows at their base.[/p][p]- Character icons now appear where you have a mission on the map.[/p][p]- Added particles and effects to the First Kingdom map.[/p][p]- Base Level Status System (Now your characters get stronger with each level).[/p][p]- Smoother pet movement.[/p][p]- Fixed camera "shakiness" and "shocks."[/p][p]- Fixed sound effects not changing volume.[/p][p]- New Frico Pet.[/p][p]- Stage shader and lighting rework.[/p][p]- Preparations for the Spooky Circus Event (a new event quest that will be activated next week).[/p][p]- Event Tickets are now dropping in Missions.[/p][p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077817/0d77da6693d2db1b7e74f86ff442c9ba3cb6fe96.png"][/img]
Stay up to date with all the news through our Discord!!
[/p][p]Best regards,[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077817/e6f89244e02888b3466f82f398a3d01261af9634.png"][/img][/p]
